name: Airbnb Business Intelligence System™
cta: Every month you wait is [another month of guessing.]
lines: hook
A booked weekend at the cabin. Five nights at the loft. Payouts landing every few days.
hook
Payouts look healthy. Until cleaning, platform fees, supplies and repairs come out.
hook
So here's the question. Which of your properties actually makes you [money?]
